set.name: Fates
set.theme: Spirit Blossom / lunar-festival setting with Ionian and Chinese mythology inspired skins (Cultist, Divine, Dusk, Elderwood, Enlightened, Exile, Fortune, Moonlight, Ninja, Spirit, Warlord).

notes.itemScope: Items come from the patch 11.1 CDragon file. Legacy entries left in that file from earlier sets were dropped: where two items share a recipe, the one with this set's icon tag was kept; disabled items (negative ids) and internal placeholders were dropped.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Chosen: shops can offer a Chosen champion that is already 2-star and costs 3x its 1-star price. One trait counts as 2, the unit gets +200 HP plus one bonus (at launch 400 HP, 30% spell power, 30 AD, or 25% reduced mana cost). Only one Chosen at a time; selling it re-enables Chosen offers. [10.19 notes, wiki Chosen]

Chosen tier odds at launch by level: L1-3 100/0/0/0/0, L4 40/60/0/0/0, L5 20/50/30/0/0, L6 10/45/45/0/0, L7 0/30/40/30/0, L8 0/20/40/40/0, L9 0/0/30/40/30. Shown at least one Chosen by 2-2 from 10.21. [10.19 notes, wiki Chosen]
Tier 5 champions that change how death works: Sett, Zilean, Lee Sin. [10.19 notes]
Fortune trait: loss streak builds an orb payout on win. [CDragon trait text]
Kayn trait: Kayn's Liberation / Rhaast's Embrace items chose his form. [CDragon items]
systemChanges: XP: level 7 needs 36 XP (was 32), level 8 needs 56 (was 50), level 9 needs 80 (was 66). [10.19 notes]
Consecutive shops do not repeat unbought champions. [10.19 notes]

Carousel item tables fixed per carousel (first: 65% one of every item plus duplicate, 11% offense, 11% defense, 11% utility, 1.5% all Spatulas, 0.5% all Forces of Nature; see notes for later carousels). [10.19 notes]
Completed items can no longer drop from orbs. Gargoyle Stoneplate replaced Sword Breaker; Sunfire Cape replaced Red Buff. [10.19 notes]
